purpose: Evaluate evidence retrieval and packing on newly acquired publisher-authored insurance FAQ question-answer pairs; improve only on development source groups.

data_rules.eligibility: Public official insurance authority or public insurer FAQ with mechanically separable original question and answer; retain URL, acquired bytes SHA256, date and publisher terms. No LLM-generated evaluation questions or answers.
data_rules.index_content: Answer text only; original FAQ question and labels are excluded from indexed text. Document titles and provenance may be retained. All eligible source answers are distractors, not only evaluated positives.
data_rules.group: Publisher or controlling organization, keeping all document and report versions together; prior publisher exposure disqualifies a confirmatory new group.
data_rules.split: After source audit but before any model inference: sort eligible publisher groups by SHA256('source-holdout-v1:42:' + group); alternating groups dev/test. At least 3 publisher groups and 30 questions per split are required for a source-disjoint pilot; otherwise exploratory only.
data_rules.sampling: Use all eligible question-answer pairs, capped at 30 per publisher selected by SHA256 of canonical question ID. Exclude exact normalized historical question/answer duplicates and near-duplicates at character TF-IDF cosine >= 0.90; log exclusions and historical comparison coverage.
data_rules.sealing: Write and hash split manifest and test question/label files before dev model runs; do not inspect test questions, labels or per-case outputs until strategy is frozen. Test answers necessarily occur in retrieval corpus, never as query-specific injected evidence.
data_rules.limitations: Source-disjoint from accessible project history only. Model pretraining exposure and inaccessible historical artifacts cannot be ruled out. Publisher FAQ pairing is a retrieval label, not expert evidence sufficiency or personal policy adjudication.

primary_endpoint.name: publisher_macro_complete_gold_answer_retention_at_5_after_packing
primary_endpoint.definition: For each question, all normalized publisher answer chunks designated gold must occur completely in packed top-5 context; average within publisher then equally across publishers. Gold chunks are generated by an answer-only deterministic splitter, not by selecting spans favorable to a method.
primary_endpoint.selection: Select one development strategy only if absolute primary gain >= 0.03 over the pinned baseline and every guardrail passes; ties prefer simpler/faster strategy. No promotion if threshold fails.
primary_endpoint.confidence_interval: Paired publisher-cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 42; report raw group counts and caution that few groups yield unstable intervals. Held-out improvement is supported only if paired 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise inconclusive.

secondary_metrics: question-macro multi-gold Recall@1/@5/@10, separate Hit@1/@5/@10, binary-relevance nDCG@10; all @10 runs retrieve at least 10 unique candidates
complete gold evidence before packing; gold-chunk and full-answer retention before/after packing; denominators reported separately
answerable subset raw and served token F1/content agreement and literal numeric agreement, explicitly lexical diagnostics rather than semantic correctness
abstention precision/recall and answerable coverage on a separately labelled controlled missing-evidence set; empty-context controls are synthetic
citation-ID validity separately from source-semantic support; semantic support is unverified unless a blinded source review is completed
per-query retrieval and generation P50/P95, GPU peak observed memory, model/package digest, context/output limits, seeds, timeouts and failures

guardrails.label_isolation: No gold text, labels, evaluation references or test-derived thresholds in query inference; no relaxation of personal-policy safety guards.

development_budget.training: Not planned. Only justified by dev diagnosis with sufficient time for independent evaluation; would require a timestamped protocol amendment before training, never test-driven.
development_budget.stop: Stop candidate selection after 3 strategies or 09:20 UTC, whichever comes first; freeze chosen strategy and hashes before opening test. No further tuning after held-out evaluation. If acquisition or independence fails, report exploratory diagnostics and infrastructure improvements without a confirmatory gain claim.
